consigna: Hold a sustained argument of at least ten minutes — with a person, or written as a dialogue — on any topic from weeks 37 to 39.
requisitos: Two positions stated with a reason and an acknowledged limit (week 37)
At least six distinct discourse markers, spoken register only (week 38)
Two disagreements, at least one aimed at an assumption (week 39)
One digression, flagged and returned from
Six vocabulary items drawn from at least two of the three topic packs
microtareas: *Mon (10 min).* Reread your three corrected texts from weeks 37–39. Write down the single correction that appeared most often.
*Wed (5 min).* Write one paragraph that uses a framing move, a marker and a disagreement formula in three consecutive sentences.
*Fri (5 min).* Record 90 seconds arguing against a position you actually hold.
autochequeo: Are all three skills present, or did one crowd out the others?
Did the markers survive, or did they vanish once I had to think about content?
Is the disagreement still visible under all the hedging?
Did I repeat the error I identified on Monday?
Six vocabulary items from two different packs?
promptCorreccion: This is a review of three skills at once: expressing opinions, discourse markers, and diplomatic disagreement. (1) For each of the three, tell me whether it is present and whether it is done well. (2) Tell me which of the three collapsed under the pressure of doing all three. (3) Give me one sentence that would have carried all three at once. Do not correct anything outside these three areas. **No AI correction limit this week:** use the prompt, but read your three earlier corrections first. The point is to see whether you fixed anything, not to collect a fourth list.
